summary: Faster reimplementation of OpenAI's Whisper speech-to-text using CTranslate2: up to 4x faster for the same accuracy, with less memory.

sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: faster-whisper reimplements OpenAI's Whisper speech recognition model on CTranslate2, a fast inference engine for Transformers. It transcribes audio up to four times faster than openai/whisper for the same accuracy while using less memory, and 8-bit quantization makes it more efficient on CPU and GPU. It supports batched transcription, word-level timestamps, a voice activity filter and Distil-Whisper models.
sixtySeconds.problem: Original Whisper is slow and memory-hungry on long audio. faster-whisper makes transcription practical on ordinary hardware.
whoFor: People transcribing podcasts, meetings or videos
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it for big speed and memory gains over the original Whisper, without needing FFmpeg installed.
requirements: For GPU: NVIDIA cuBLAS and cuDNN 9 for CUDA 12

overview: Install from PyPI with pip install faster-whisper. FFmpeg isn't needed because audio is decoded with PyAV.
For GPU use, install cuBLAS and cuDNN for CUDA 12; on Linux they can come from pip, or use the official NVIDIA CUDA Docker image.
Load a WhisperModel such as large-v3 on cuda or cpu with a compute type like float16 or int8, then call transcribe. It is MIT licensed.
